name: Trivia Bluff
description: Round by round, the AI finds an obscure real fact with a blank. Students write believable lies to fill it, then everyone votes for the truth among the fakes. Points for spotting the truth, points for every classmate your lie fools.
tagline: The Fibbage shape: a quick-witted bluffing game that gets sharper with every round.

rounds.label: How many rounds
rounds.helper: Each round is a fresh AI-found fact: write lies, then vote. Plan on 6 to 8 minutes per round.

lieTimer.label: Lie-writing time (seconds)
lieTimer.helper: How long students get to write their fake answer each round.

template.name: Trivia Bluff
template.description: A fact with a blank and believable lies. Pick the truth to score; fool the class to score too.

intro.message:
TRIVIA BLUFF!

You'll see an obscure fact with a blank. Write a believable lie to fill it in. The class will then try to spot the truth, but your lie might fool them!

fact${i}.instruction:
Generate ONE classroom-appropriate, obscure-but-real trivia fact for a fill-in-the-blank bluffing game. This is round ${i} of ${n} in one session. So that rounds never repeat a topic, pick this round's category by its number: 1 = your pick, any surprising topic; 2 = geography or world places; 3 = animals or nature; 4 = food and drink; 5 = history or inventions; 6 = sports, games, or odd laws. This is round ${i}, so use category ${i}, and within it choose an unexpected fact. Return ONLY a JSON object (no preamble) with these fields:
  - category: short topic name (e.g. "Geography", "Science", "History")
  - question: a sentence with a blank shown as ___ that students will try to guess. Keep it specific. (e.g. "The mayor of Rabbit Hash, Kentucky is a ___.")
  - truth: the real word or short phrase that fills the blank (e.g. "dog")
  - houseLie: a believable but wrong alternative the system can mix into the choices (e.g. "chicken")

Make sure the truth is genuinely surprising and that a thoughtful classroom guess could plausibly land on the truth or a lie. No politics, no sensitive topics.

lies${i}.prompt:
{{fact${i}.result.question}}

Write a lie that could fool the class.

reveal${i}.message:
The truth was: {{fact${i}.result.truth}}!

What the class picked:
{{vote${i}.barChart}}

Liars, own up! Whose lie pulled the most votes?

end.message: That's Trivia Bluff! 100 for spotting the truth, 50 per classmate fooled. Run it again for fresh facts.
